title: Require Domain Ops Contract Registry Surface
forbids: ops/contract.ts registries exposing constituent operation contracts or any authority besides their singular default registry
why: The operation-contract registry is one typed aggregate consumed by the module contract and implementation registry. Keeping constituent contracts private prevents alternate import routes and preserves operation ownership.
remediate: Default-import each sibling operation contract, assemble one private const contracts registry, export it as default, and remove every constituent named re-export.
message: Domain ops/contract.ts must expose one default contract registry authority only.
